title: World, Scene, Combat, Exploration & Creator Integration
objective: Deterministic integration handoff from validated MAI-08 presentation drafts into explicit World, Scene, Visibility, Combat/Exploration and Creator/D29 owner requests and acknowledgements without inferring or independently mutating owner truth.

resolved_contract.input_boundary: Validate MAI-08 draft/receipt and preserved evidence; fail closed on invalid, unresolved, stale or unpermitted input before owner requests.
resolved_contract.world: Carry explicit MIB-11/D18 references only; presentation geometry cannot create World hierarchy/topology/navigation truth.
resolved_contract.scene: Emit A5 semantic Scene/map-version/placement proposals with expected versions and operation IDs; only A5 results mutate runtime Scene state.
resolved_contract.visibility: Carry policy references and visual hints only; authorization/projection owners decide audience/hidden/occlusion/LOS truth.
resolved_contract.gameplay: Carry explicit governed owner bindings only; visual walls/connectivity/geometry cannot automatically create collision/cover/movement/interaction/trigger/portal/consequence truth.
resolved_contract.creator: Carry MAI evidence into D29 proposal flow; review, publication and canonical promotion remain separate owner gates and MAI receipts are not PublicationReceipts.
resolved_contract.reconciliation: Partial and ambiguous owner acknowledgements remain explicit; ambiguous outcomes require operation-status lookup before retry.
resolved_contract.receipt: Canonical request/decision ordering produces deterministic platform-neutral integration/reconciliation evidence only.
resolved_contract.persistence: No new MAI-owned durable integration ledger was required; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
